title: Ingenuity Mars Helicopter's record-breaking flight (Flight 25, 2022-04-18)
contents: Ingenuity's own navigation camera over Mars: 704 m at 5.5 m/s, its longest and fastest flight. 640x480 source, silent, 35 s.
